engine.name: DSI Tetra
engine.description: Dave Smith Instruments Tetra, layers A and B, every voice and global parameter in its manual's NRPN tables.

sources.title: Tetra Manual (version 1.3)
sources.notes: NRPN tables read by tools/profiles/sequential/read-nrpn-tables.mjs from Tetra_Manual_v.1.3.pdf, pages 57-58-63 (sha256 eb29e174cdc0337484630970c63b2075a00f709f926f69b7f663a12073fdc06d), https://sequential.com/downloads/tetra/doc/Tetra_Manual_v.1.3.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/sequential/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/sequential/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's NRPN tables, on its number, with its printed range and name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Values go out as the manual prints the format: NRPN MSB/LSB on CC 99/98, value MSB/LSB on CC 6/38. The instrument must have its Global MIDI parameter receive set to NRPN (or All).
1 parameter(s) the manual marks as transmitted but ignored when received are read-only.
Left out, the program name, one character per NRPN; CEditor cannot edit text over NRPN yet: NRPN 184-199.
